authority: Implementation audit; not a new product contract
guidanceOnly: New fixtures must explicitly isolate personal configuration where outside their scenario; repaired fixtures enforce their own selectors, not a repository-wide prohibition.
Diagnose every independent gate failure and observe focused repair passing before another full run.
Change experiment after two attempts without a discriminating result; separate 30-minute fixture repair budget.
Declare expected duration and wall-clock stop time for ad-hoc commands.
Accepted-goal relevance and sufficiency of selected checks require judgment; CHECKS.md owns the decision process, not an automatic semantic proof.
limitations: Receipt API fixtures catch known contract drift; they do not automatically migrate arbitrary future fields.
Harness tests validate known shebang, repair ordering, receipt mutation and unpack-limit failures; future changes still require focused acceptance preflight.

Coverage fixtures enforce compiled private exports, unowned CommonJS native interop and nested cold source-runtime construction; process readiness under instrumentation still needs affected consumer checks.
Fresh-edit composition fixtures enforce matching physical mutation, patch and new finding; a changed tool-call ID alone is not freshness evidence.
Incomplete statement ends require unique authored range; positive aliases also require same-context precise hits. Unresolved geometry and counters remain strict.

Compiled-preload regression proves exact owned token removal while unrelated preload/options and raw source preload remain active. It does not qualify process readiness under arbitrary host contention.

Installed resident canaries execute packaged bytes through the existing launcher test port; source clients retain instrumentation. Exact archive identity and focused/full scope remain separate. Host scheduling cannot be guaranteed by these tests.
